about: The requirement sentences bench/acceptance/candidates-v2.json added on 2026-09-23 (issue #37's search for a case in a sibling), each written by hand from a merged pull request's text and labelled before the first request. A second set beside sentences.json, whose log (form-choice-v1.json) records that set's sha256 and is not added to: this one has its own log, form-choice-v2.json, under the same question and bar.

sentences.label: failure_propagation
sentences.text: Sending a message to a target session that has already closed must reach the caller as a failure, not be reported as delivered.

sentences.label: failure_propagation
sentences.text: If a SQLite database cannot be opened with its file-backed limits, the failure must reach the caller as an error, not be replaced by an in-memory connection.

sentences.label: failure_propagation
sentences.text: If the config registry file cannot be read or parsed, the failure must reach the caller as an error, not be returned as an empty set.

sentences.label: failure_propagation
sentences.text: When transliteration fails, the error must reach the caller as an error, not be ignored or returned as null.

sentences.label: failure_propagation
sentences.text: If an OAuth token refresh fails, the failure must reach the caller as an error, not be returned as the stale token.

sentences.label: failure_propagation
sentences.text: When every claim fails in plan or apply, the failure must reach the caller as an error, not let the command continue as if it succeeded.

sentences.label: failure_propagation
sentences.text: If reading a row of the running set fails, the error must reach the caller, not be dropped so that the caller sees a truncated set.
